answer: Make each identity earn non-transferable reputation only by completing peer-attested useful tasks over many epochs, so a fresh identity starts at zero and cannot buy trust instantly. A Sybil farm would have to do real work on every island of fake accounts, paying compute and time for each one, while honest agents keep building a longer horizon of verified history. Climbing to the summit of influence then costs the attacker as much genuine work as the whole honest network, not just a flood of cheap copies.
